title: Planet Tweaks V2.3.7 ULTRA — Expandable Patch Notes, Deleted Tabs Vault & Auto-Relaunch Updater
releaseNotes: Expandable Patch Notes: Added dedicated dropdown viewer in Settings and top banner to easily read full release details without crowding. Double Right-Click to Delete Sidebar Tabs: Clean up navigation by double right-clicking tabs into the new '🗑️ Deleted Tabs Vault'. Direct Vault Access: Launch hidden tabs directly from Deleted Tabs without restoring them to the sidebar. One-Click Restore: Instant restore and Restore All functionality for hidden tabs. Auto-Relaunch on Update: Planet Tweaks automatically relaunches in the foreground when updates complete. Sub-Millisecond Input Precision: Native hardware timestamp spin-loops and zero sleep quantization.
